items.title: Party reordering, continuous Auto Summon and in-dock companion decisions
items.quote: You should be able to hold or long press and drag a character or companion if you have the non-collapsed menu ... drag and re-order them and it changed the position on the map and re-orient them. You should also only be asked to release a companion if you don’t choose auto. Auto should move to a single button ... a menu that shows the current odds in a clean table ... Which rarity should you stop at? ... Start auto summoning. It auto summons until you run out of shards ... if you have the three option unlocked ... open three books ... in the same time you would open up one. If you have auto summon running, it should shake like normal and then pop little sprites ... half the size of the little tome at the bottom ... then fade away for the one behind it ... open 20 at a time ... quickly flash one at a time ... in that tiny view. It only pops up with the full character if you have not discovered it yet, or if it is a rarity that you have selected that you wanted to stop at regardless of whether you have already opened it or not.

asks.text: The ticked Auto rarities are saved as a new setting in the save. Old saves need no update. Older copies of the game ignore the setting and stop at the lowest ticked rarity instead. Please say if that's OK.
Players who bought the Auto capacity upgrade with Gold paid for a limit that no longer exists. I gave nothing back. I can refund that Gold if you want, but that changes the economy.

items.title: Intro-style companion pages with shared type habitats and size/weight
items.quote: I want you to ask to have all the companion pages look like the first intro egg pages, and if there isn’t a background for it let me know. It should just be one per type not one per each companion. Also drop the one line sentences and just put weights and sizes like in pokemon, it can generate them based on the name.

asks.text: Your Google Drive art (the new Treasure Hall set, plus pictures held for a check) can't reach the game until the artwork delivery steps in #52 are approved. These are a Drive sign-in for the build and a decision on where about 300 MB of art is stored.

items.title: Lower battlefield characters and enlarge bosses by 40%
items.quote: Send these two in. I need them to lower to just above the challenge boss when collapsed and when not collapsed it’s ok for them to be covered. I also need the size of the bosses increased by 40%. Also make sure the health icon doesn’t cover them.

items.title: Keep automatic combat running behind menus and other tabs
items.quote: Before that I want the auto battler to continue no matter what menu or anything is present.

asks.text: Merging this when you're happy with it. It changes when the game pauses, and nothing in the economy, odds or saves.

items.title: Build approved premium Treasure Hall after verified artwork retrieval
items.quote: Build the approved Treasure Hall redesign using the detailed layout specification and artwork manifest on branch review/treasure-hall-premium-concept-20261027. Match the approved mobile composite exactly. All ten original PNGs are in the Google Drive Treasure Hall artwork folder. Have Claude verify access and SHA-256 checksums before integrating anything. Follow the existing Noah review process.

asks.text: Get the ten approved Treasure Hall pictures and the approved v03 mockup to the builder in a private place it can read. The easiest way: download them from the Drive folder "LOREBOUND Artwork Inbox → Approved → Treasure-Hall-Revamp-v1" without changing them. Then push them…

The Sixfold Covenant trophy is a new goal the game doesn't track yet. My suggestion: work it out each time the Hall opens from what's already saved, and save nothing new. The layout spec says you must look at this before it's built. Is that OK?

A trophy earned for the first time should glow once and then never replay. The game already remembers this for the Chronicle, Guardian Memorial and Last Vigil trophies. For the Crown and the Sixfold Covenant it would have to remember two new things, and that changes what a…

items.title: Replace nine companion sprites with Joshua's approved art
Connect approved Drive artwork library and verify private developer staging
items.quote: I want to establish a permanent artwork delivery pipeline so I can generate and approve artwork in ChatGPT, then have Claude Code access it through GitHub without me downloading, extracting or re-uploading ZIP files. Create a build-request pull request for Noah’s Claude Code builder. Do not implement gameplay changes. Do not call this complete unless the source-to-developer transfer has been verified.

asks.text: Drive access. In a Google Cloud project you control, turn on the Drive API. Create a service account with no project roles. Share only the "LOREBOUND Artwork Inbox" folder with it, as Viewer. Keep the folder private and link sharing off. It's free and there's nothing to deploy.

The login itself. I suggest short-lived logins through Workload Identity Federation, so no key is stored. The simpler choice is a JSON key saved as the repository secret ART_INBOX_SA_KEY. Please don't paste any key into a comment.
A fetch workflow. Add one you start by hand, with only contents: read and id-token: write. I'm not allowed to edit .github/workflows. It should:

Where the original pictures live. I suggest keeping them in Drive and fetching them when needed, because putting about 300 MB into Git history is costly. The other choices are Git LFS on a private branch, or committing the PNGs.
Whether to merge this checker now, before the Drive access exists. It changes no game files and publishes nothing.

items.requestStatus: Partly built, waiting for answers (transfer not verified)
